title: Triples as Functions on Three Coordinates
statement: For any set $D$, the set of functions from $\mathrm{Fin}(3)$ to $D$ is in bijection with $D\times D\times D$, by sending a function to its values at coordinates $0$, $1$, and $2$. The inverse assigns those three entries to the corresponding coordinates.
